name: @cms/adapter-cerafica
description: Adapter for the cerafica host repository. Implements the @cms/adapter-sdk Adapter interface (frozen 1.0.0) plus provisional 1.0.0-rc.1 extensions (field_capabilities, DeployCapability). Authoritative host contract lives in cerafica/website/cms-regions.json (manifestSchema=cms-regions/v1). Products canonical path is inventory/products.json; served alias website/data/products.json is a filesystem symlink. The adapter resolves it via real lstat/readlink/realpath and refuses to write through alias paths.
